Text_lang: The Winter Queen has asked for you to deliver a message to Sire Denathrius, the Master of Revendreth. You will need his help for the coming conflict.
Test
Following an unprovoked assault on Bastion, you were tasked with journeying to Maldraxxus and investigating why the armies of the dead have betrayed their oath to defend the Shadowlands.

Using a set of blueprints you recovered and the destructive capabilities of the G.M.O.D. at your disposal, you and Gallywix managed to destroy an airship utilized by High Tinker Mekkatorque and set Alliance interests in Drustvar back even further.

Khadgar has summoned you to Dalaran to help him investigate a mysterious figure called the Harbinger who possesses a powerful relic called the Dark Heart. The Archmage has also asked Alleria Windrunner to join you in order to give her unique perspective.
You were summoned to Silithus to seek out Magni, the Speaker of Azeroth, in order to learn more about the mysterious Radiant Song being heard all across Azeroth.

Orweyna reveals that she found a recording from none other than Gallywix, the leader of the operations around Opportunity Point. But she is worried about what she heard behind a massive cave wall. Machines grinding and drilling with a purpose that remains hidden, for now...
You were summoned to Silithus to seek out Magni, the Speaker of Azeroth, in order to learn more about the mysterious Radiant Song being heard all across Azeroth.
With reagents gathered and souls recovered, you prepare to witness the somber fruits of Sylvanas' everlasting toil.

Xal'atath and her Devouring Host have launched a direct assault on the Sunwell. In response to a desperate prayer from Liadrin, the Light has summoned Azeroth's champions to defend Quel'Danas. You must now drive back the darkness and find a way to vanquish Xal'atath once and for all.

With the help of Xal'atath you have managed to beat back the void in the Oasis eco-dome. Soul-Scribe tasked you with collecting items for the coming Tabiqa ritual, though she does not have much faith that anything will come of trying to connect with K'aresh. The time has come to try, however, and your fate depends on whether Xal'atath is telling the truth...

Satisfied with your assistance, Ve'nari has given you his Reshii Ribbon. While powerful, the Ribbon is not enough on its own to stop Dimensius. Locus-Walker is aware of another in the keeping of his friend and fellow Ravel member, Om'bera. The decision is made to move on to Eco-dome Gammon but Alleria departs, stating that she will check on the situation with the Shadowguard. It is clear that she is not accepting of the presence of Xal'atath.

You witnessed a Steamwheedle scientist being forced to test Black Blood weapons, stabilized using kaja'mite. The successful test would allow Gallywix to use the kaja'mite and Black Blood to repair the Dark Heart.

At the edge of crackling amethyst glass, Xal'atath begins to weave her plan to draw the Wastelanders to your cause. Denizens of the void prowl the Tempest Fields, their presence a testament to the failing boundaries between K'aresh and the void. Xal'atath has brought you here with the promise of gaining the murderous Wastelanders as allies.

Orweyna bid you farewell, unable to travel with you further. Suddenly, a small spider arrived with a message for you--a request that you follow it to the sender. When you arrive, you meet the Widow Arak'nai, otherwise known as The Weaver--and she has a deal for you. If you help her try to take out the dark forces influencing Queen Ansurek, she'll help you find your friends.

You and the Arathi fought valiantly against the nerubian onslaught, but it was too much. Anduin sacrificed himself to allow you, Faerin, and Alleria to board the airship The Reckoning and rain fire down upon the nerubians.

You arrived at Faerin's Advance, where Faerin Lothar is collecting refugees from the nerubians. Oddly enough, these people have been escaping on their own. You are then tasked with meeting up with Flynn Fairwind. Together, you find vital intel about what's been going on--and you decide to sneak into Siegehold to investigate further while Flynn meets with the Weaver.
With the Oathsworn and Unbound united in purpose, Coreway access to the Ringing Deeps is restored. It will take much more time to clear the rest of the Coreway.
Dalaran rushed to the aid of Khaz Algar, only for the Archmage Drenden to reveal himself to be Xal'atath in disguise. She attacked Dalaran with an army of nerubians at her command.

In cave beneath the tower, the Order of Night worked to keep the tower dark. You fight them and escaped the confines of the cave with Faerin and Anduin, who revealed the grief they each struggle with. In performing a ritual to restore the Sacred Flame with Faerin, Anduin felt just a touch of the Light again.
Talking to Gundargaz citizens, you learned of other problems he's neglected. You decided to investigate an incursion of kobolds.

Xal'atath has stunned Soul-Scribe with a tantilizing secret: K'aresh may not be dead after all. She suggests you all move to the Oasis to perform the Tabiqa ritual. Soul-Scribe is hessitant, but her daughter Narathe says that they must at least try to connect to the worldsoul. Soul-Scribe agrees to the attempt, but warns that Xal'atath's words had better not be false.

After a whirlwind battle out of the City of Threads and an intense encounter with Xal'atath, you returned to the Weaver's Lair to let her know what you learned. There is no redeeming Queen Ansurek--she is willingly working with Xal'atath. The Weaver thanks you for finding her another ally, and requests your presence when she reaches out to the General and Vizier, while Alleria and Anduin return to the surface.
Renzik's death at the hands of Nikki the Fixer kicked off violence in the streets of Undermine.
With Pamsy's help, the Black Blood pumps were stopped. Now it is time to follow the Black Blood to it's destination, in Undermine.

Alleria and Faerin steered the ship recklessly into Azj'kahet in pursuit of Anduin's captors, but the nerubians were prepared. The Reckoning was entrapped in webs, and the Arathi forces scattered below.
You rushed back to Gundargaz, where you faced a conspiracy of Machine Speakers firmly loyal to the High Speaker and fought your way to the Hall of Awakening in pursuit of the High Speaker.

The Candle King has been bullying kobolds. You stole his crown and formed an alliance with the peaceful kobolds, like Skitter. After returning to Gundargaz, Dagran suggested you investigate suspicious events in a mining town called Taelloch. Moira returned to the surface to inform Adelgonn and her warriors.

Finding the fuses inoperative during the defense of the Cinderbrew Meadery, Baelgrim had no choice but to ignite the kegs himself. Queensguard Zirix was slain, but Baelgrim gave his life to enact his plan.
In the Archive in Dornogal, you met the rest of the acting Council of Dornogal, Speaker Brinthe and Councilward Merrix, and deposited a memory gem into the Archive.
The Council of Dornogal realized they could not rebuild the Coreway without the Unbound, the earthen who had abandoned their oaths. You and Baelgrim left to seek out the Unbound leader, Adelgonn.
Alleria Windrunner sensed Black Blood in Hallowfall, where it should not have been. She has asked you to continue the hunt.
Zirdo was promoted for his slimy ways by Gallywix to Overseer of the Heaps, but he will not live to commit another betrayal.

While fighting your way through the Shadowguards' forward base, Xal'atath revealed to Alleria and you that the Ravel used the Reshii Ribbons to destroy K'aresh in hopes that it would destroy Dimensius in the process. They have failed. 
Alleria's trust in her mentor, Locus-Walker, has now completely diminished. She is heading to Eco-Dome Primus to confront him.
Alleria Windrunner has heard of a concerning issue with the Shadowguard Etherials from her mentor, Locus-Walker. She has asked for you to meet with Locus-Walker in Dornogal.

You, Faerin, and Anduin traveled across Hallowfall and rescued villagers from the kobyss, against the orders of General Steelstrike. But then, a sudden blast of shadow darkened the land even farther. The three of you found the that the nearby Dawntower had been corrupted with a dark flame.
Stormward Baelgrim and his Stormriders thwarted the nerubian Queensguard Zirix's ambush, but an explosion in the earthen city of Dornogal called them and Dalaran's survivors to investigate.

Magni tried to commune with Azeroth to learn what the Radiant Song was warning us about but fell unconscious during the process. With the aid of the Dalaran archmages, there was still hope of recovery.
In Freywold, Adelgonn rebuffed Baelgrim. You and Moira gained her trust by rescuing her people.

Nikki the Fixer paid the price for killing Renzik, forcing Gallywix to retreat into his fortress-like casino. While he is safe from goblin justice for now, Gallywix no longer has his grip on the city and its people. A new era dawns for Undermine.
Gallywix and his Darkfuse have been spreading over Undermine, into the territory of friendly and hostile cartels.

After assisting the Stormriders with the nerubians, Dalaran's survivors regrouped in Dornogal and went their separate ways: Jaina and Thrall to call reinforcements, Alleria to hunt Xal'atath, and the rest staying to help the earthen.

Pamsy revealed she was the one who brought down the wall that brought your attention. She hoped getting outsider's attention could save her workers. But Zirdo betrayed you all for a reward and the Darkfuse Overseer had Pamsy's crew killed.

After fighting your way across the void glass and defeating the ravenous Zagithav the Essence Gorger, you are confronted by Soul-Scribe and her Wastelanders. Xal'atath, in an uncharacteristic moment, has shared the story of her own world's destruction by Dimensius. She promised the Wastelanders a chance at revenge, but the secretive ethereals do not make allies lightly. Perhaps showing them that you are on their side will help, while the Harbinger works her whispers.
After realizing that Locus-Walker has allied himself with Xal'atath, he wishes Alleria and you to join him as The Trust is ready to take the fight to the real enemy - The Shadowguard and Dimensius.
You arrived in Taelloch with Magni and Dagran to search for the missing foreman. You found frightened survivors sequested in their homes... and evidence of earthen transforming into skardyn!
Seeking to find allies against a common threat, you accompanied Anduin into Hallowfall in search of the Arathi.
Alleria joined you and the goblins in Undermine as you began your investigation of Noggenfogger's involvement.
Baelgrim wanted to rally the Stormriders to protect the Unbound from another nerubian attack on the Coreway, and went to the Stormperch in Storm's Watch to do so.

A rocket drill has taken your band to Undermine, the center of goblin society. Pamsy's pal, Grimla Fizzlecrank, has volunteered to get you acquainted with the place so you can pick up the trail of the Black Blood.

Orweyna has found the trail of the Black Blood again. Revilgaz and Blackwater are moving it through Undermine, and Ethereals seem to be lurking in the shadows. Orweyna set out to get Alleria to help as the rest of you went to question Revilgaz.

You then travelled to Mereldar and discovered that the Order of Night had been recruiting Arathi who gave into their fear of Beledar's Shadow. As you investigated, the kobyss attacked the Veneration Grounds, drawn by the Order of Night leader Aleric Leid's magic.

After Alleria destroyed Aleric Leid's shadow barriers, you slew him. But the Arathi were given no time to rest. The nerubians assaulted the town of Livia's Patience. You accompanied Faerin, Alleria, and Anduin to evacuate the town.

Magni awoke with new insight into the Radiant Song. Azeroth has been trying to warn us that Khaz Algar, a titan installation from legend, is in danger. Dalaran will teleport to the island to defend it.

Your investigations and informants revealed Gallywix unleashed goblins to mine Black Blood, the substance that mutated the nerubians and empowered Xal'atath's Dark Heart. An informant named Zirdo seems willing to tell you more and lead you deeper into the caves.

You and Speaker Brinthe arrived in the Ringing Deeps to meet the Machine Speakers. The local leader, the High Speaker, was obsessed with restoring a titan Awakening Machine that shut down millennia ago. Unable to recharge their life force, long-lived earthen are shutting down one by one.
You discovered Venture was running a kaja'mite mine in Zuldazar, and trading the kaja'mite to Gallywix for weapons powered by Black Blood.

In Siegehold, you meet with the General Anub'azal. His position has been usurped by one of the "ascended" named Zev'kall. Anub'azal asks for your aid in ruining Zev'kall's reputation, offering to help you escape Siegehold with the other refugees in return. Upon successfully escaping, you return to the Weaver with news of this potential new ally.

The Weaver has a message for you from a mysterious figure known only as The Vizier. The Vizier has important matters to discuss, and requests your presence in the City of Threads--the nerubian capital city.

You headed to the airdocks at Tenir's Ascent to defend against the nerubian forces. There, Alleria reappeared and with her help you defeated the nerubian leader of the assault. You learned she had been tracking the nerubians who attacked Dalaran.

After familiarizing yourself with the Weaver's Lair, she offers you the first of her favors--if you investigate the goings-on in and around the military headquarters known as Siegehold, she'll give you the location of some of your allies. The Weaver is in search of allies of her own, and if you follow her lead, perhaps you can find another similarly-minded nerubian to ally with.
Orweyna and you attacked the Black Blood pumps, but a goblin engineer, Pamsy, pointed out that a direct attack on the pumps would make things worse.

You and Anduin saw a crystal as bright as the sun, then Anduin once more heard the Radiant Song. You both encountered a lamplighter named Faerin who recruited you for a mission to rescue soldiers at the Fallen Aegis Wall.

Baelgrim found the Stormriders in the Stormperch had been corrupted by some dark power. With their forces almost wiped out, the Stormriders cannot protect Dornogal. Baelgrim devised a new plan to battle the nerubian threat at the Cinderbrew Meadery.
After Xal'atath's attack, Dalaran crashed on the Isle of Dorn. The city's survivors worked to repel a waiting nerubian ambush.

You have traveled to the Broker city of Tazavesh, now relocated to the ruins of K'aresh. There you have learned that the Brokers and the Etherials are working together to rebuild the remains of their shattered homeworld. However, not all appears to be going well as you have encountered multiple instances of sabotage, setting back the rebuilding effort.
Brinthe became the next High Speaker, pledging the Machine Speakers' support against the nerubians.

Dalaran's survivors reached Dornogal and found the earthen in disarray due to an ongoing nerubian attack. They also found the Coreway, an earthen-forged passage to Azeroth's core, had been sabotaged in the attack.

You rushed back to Noggenfogger to find he was under attack by Ethereals, who were also after the Dark Heart. With Alleria's help you fought them off, but the race is on. You need to reach the Dark Heart, and the hostages Gallywix is using to control the other trade princes, before your enemies do.
At the Aegis Wall, you helped Faerin, Anduin, and the Lamplighter Kyron light the keyflame and blunt the nerubian assault.

The High Speaker reactivated the Awakening Machine with Xal'atath's artifact... and an overload suffused him with Void energy! Transformed and overwhelmed, he fled. At that moment, Magni realized a new potential within himself: he entered the Awakening Machine... emerging transformed by the World Soul. His actions allowed a new generation of earthen to awaken, led by the first among their kind: Dawn.

You and Orweyna decimated Venture Co.'s stockpile of Black Blood weapons. Nikki the Fixer harried you with her nigh-invincible Executive Package, but Pamsy handed off parts to Gazlowe that may let him invent a weapon to defeat her. Gazlowe arrived with a city's worth of goblins ready to march on Gallywix's casino and take back Undermine.
Noggenfogger is working for Gallywix against his will. He couldn't say much, but he did set you on the trail of Venture Company's kaja'mite mines.

Khadgar has summoned you to Dalaran to help him investigate a mysterious figure called the Harbinger who possesses a powerful relic called the Dark Heart. The Archmage has also asked Alleria Windrunner to join you in order to give her unique perspective.
You were summoned to Silithus to seek out Magni, the Speaker of Azeroth, in order to learn more about the mysterious Radiant Song being heard all across Azeroth.
Adelgonn rejoined the Council and the Unbound and Oathsworn began working together again. The Unbound started repairing the Coreway after receiving orders from Merrix.

After helping Ve'nari stabilize and protect Eco-Dome Primus, you are now headed to the Serrated Peaks, taking the fight to the enemy. 
You sense a looming shadow as if something is not right. Something is being kept away from you. Perhaps Xal'atath's presence and ability drive you into madness and doubt in your own logic. 
For now, Alleria and you will conduct a series of small-scale missions within the enemy base, ensuring the future survival of the Eco-Dome Project.

You and Gazlowe couldn't stop Nikki the Fixer, but the revolution rages on. Gazlowe stayed behind to rally the people of Bilgewater and sent you to deal with the Black Blood smugglers at the Blackwater Marina.

After saving the soldiers you could, Faerin Lothar sent you to look into the mysterious figure who aided you during the airship attack. You encounter her underground, where she is investigating a substance known as Black Blood. Orweyna asks for your help in cleaning things up--but it appears that the haranir, as her people are called, aren't happy with her efforts at diplomacy.

Your investigation into the sabotague in Tazavesh has revealed that the Shadowguard, Etherials who strive to resurrect the void lord Dimensius, are culprits!
Unfortunately, as you share the news of your discovery to your allies the Shadowguard unleashed an overwhelming attack upon the city!
After preparing the Cinderbrew Meadery to defend against the nerubians, Baelgrim enacted his plan to lure the nerubians into the meadery and then ignite the explosive cinderbrew kegs.
Reunited with Anduin, you and Alleria returned to the surface and gather your allies.
You arrived to find goblins have set up a major operation. Time to investigate the work camps and find out what they are after.
The trail of the Black Blood has led to Gallywix, Darkfuse oppression and a mysterious ethereal, but the painful blow was discovering Marin Noggenfogger is somehow involved.

You and your allies have heroically worked to halt the Shadowguard attack upon Tazavesh and reinforce the city's protective shield. As you defeated the leader of the Shadowguard forces Locus-Walker introduced us to his mysterious ally... Xal'atath!
Alleria was not happy with this revelation.

You helped Fleetmaster Seahorn reclaim the Blackwater Marina and stop the flow of Black Blood into the Undermine. Grimla, Pamsy, and Orweyna need your aid to stop Venture Company loyalists from turning their existing stockpiles into new weapons.

An explosion has opened the way to a new cavern in the Ringing Deeps. This was in the same location Orweyna's visions and Gazlowe's investigations led them. With their obstacles removed, they want your help to investigate what lies beyond.
Revilgaz has no loyalty to Gallywix and is willing to help you out. He sent you to a drop site where the Black Blood was sent to be distributed.

Soul-Scribe performed the Tabiqa ritual using the items you gathered. It was not going well, until Xal'atath stepped in. The Harbinger drained the energy from the Wastelanders, boosting the ritual spell. Soul-Scribe's anger was swiftly changed to wonder as she heard the voice of K'aresh for the first time since the sundering of the world. Awed and grateful, she has pledged herself and her people to fight by your side against Dimensius, and will turn over her Reshii Ribbon.

Eco-dome: Rhovan was destroyed by a meteor and was overrun by void-touched creatures. A Wastelander dagger, once used for the Tabiqa ritual, was found buried in Om'bera's chest, with her Reshii Ribbon nowhere in sight. Due to his part in helping the Ravel destroy K'aresh, the Wastelanders are hunting Locus-Walker and will attempt to kill him on sight. Xal'atath believes the Wastelanders will be useful in the coming battle against Dimensius and encouraged Locus-Walker to stay behind while the two of you work towards gaining their aid.
The Lamplighters ignited the dawntower at Tenir's Ascent just in time. The star Beledar shifted to shadow, bringing darkness to Hallowfall.

You found the foreman, who had sealed herself inside a cave before transforming into a tormented skardyn. After slaying her, we found a memory gem with further revelations: the High Speaker and Xal'atath plan to "reawaken" all the earthen as skardyn!

The hostages were freed, but Gallywix has escaped, and the Dark Heart was taken by one of the ethereals. Gazlowe seems to have lost his will to fight for Undermine. Alleria had to leave and continue her hunt for the Dark Heart.

Using pheromones that you obtained in Siegehold, you manage to make your way into the city without being attacked. The Vizier is revealed to be Executor Nizrek--Queen Ansurek's closest advisor, in theory--and he has Anduin Wrynn with him. You are tasked with viewing the Ascension Day speech and witnessing Ansurek's willing embrace of darker powers.
